blocks.text: Sulfur ki oxidation states −2, 0, +2, +4 aur +6 hain. Sulfur ki electronic configuration Figure 12.8 mein hai; oxidation state unpaired (akele) electrons ki number (tadaad) se tay hoti hai. Aam (standard) conditions (halaat) mein sulfur aur oxygen react kar ke sulfur dioxide (SO₂) banate hain, jis mein sulfur ki oxidation state +4 hai. Lekin sulfur trioxide (SO₃), jis mein oxidation state +6 hai, banane ke liye zyada energy chahiye.

blocks.alt: Chaar rows mein orbital boxes. a) Oxygen ground state 2s2 2p4: second shell (doosre khol) mein d-orbitals nahi, is liye excitation mumkin nahi. b) Sulfur ground state 3s2 3p4, paanch khali 3d: do unpaired electrons se 2+. c) Pehli excited state 3s2 3p3 3d1: chaar unpaired se 4+. d) Doosri excited state 3s1 3p3 3d2: chhe unpaired se 6+.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.8: Different (alag alag) oxidation states ke liye sulfur ki electronic configurations (kitab ki Figure 12.8 jaisa original diagram).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Row (b) se (c) tak 3p ka ek jora toot kar ek electron 3d mein chala jata hai (3p se 3d promotion), aur (c) se (d) tak 3s ka ek electron bhi 3d mein jata hai (3s se 3d). Har unpaired electron ek bond bana sakta hai, is liye 2, 4 aur 6 unpaired electrons se +2, +4 aur +6 states milti hain. Oxygen ke second shell mein d-orbitals nahi, is liye wahan yeh promotion nahi hota.

blocks.caption: Sulfur ki oxidation states (Figure 12.8)
rows: chhe (3s aur 3p ka ek ek electron 3d mein)

blocks.prompt: Figure 12.8 ke hisaab se +4 aur +6 oxidation states ke liye sulfur ke kitne unpaired electrons hote hain, aur yeh kaise bante hain?
blocks.explanation: +4 ke liye chaar unpaired electrons: 3p ka ek electron 3d mein chala jata hai (pehli excited state, 3s² 3p³ 3d¹). +6 ke liye chhe: 3s ka ek electron bhi 3d mein chala jata hai (doosri excited state, 3s¹ 3p³ 3d²).

items: Oxidation states: −2, 0, +2, +4, +6; unpaired electrons ki number se tay.
3p aur 3s electrons ke 3d mein jane se 4 aur 6 unpaired electrons: +4 aur +6.
S + O₂ aasani se SO₂ (+4) deta hai; SO₃ (+6) ke liye zyada energy chahiye.
